item.title: Corner of Maguire Street and Shad Thames (///study.rail.tulip), 3rd September
item.description:
This Biffa waste container has been left immediately adjacent to Wheat Wharf, on the corner of Maguire Street and Shad Thames, for over a week. I am a Director of Wheat Wharf, which is a Grade II listed former warehouse building. We are concerned that the container has been abandoned in direct contact with, or extremely close to, the building and could cause damage to the historic brickwork. Please could you arrange for the container to be removed as a matter of urgency and confirm when this will be done. Many thanks, Julian Griffiths-Searle Director, Wheat Wharf

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Shad Thames, Bermondsey, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
